_comment: This file is a pytest test suite for pybind11 C++ enum bindings. It contains only test functions that assert behavior of C++ enums exposed to Python via pybind11. There are no callable APIs, utility functions, or classes intended for end-user invocation. No argparse-compatible CLI entry points exist.
test_unscoped_enum: test pybind11 unscoped enum string representation, name property, and integer comparison behavior
test_scoped_enum: test pybind11 scoped enum string representation and verify it rejects integer comparisons
test_implicit_conversion: test pybind11 class-scoped unscoped enum implicit conversion and hashing as dictionary keys
test_binary_operators: test pybind11 flags enum bitwise OR, AND, NOT, and XOR operators
test_enum_to_int: test pybind11 enum implicit conversion to int, uint, and long long types
